__comment: Master calendar / time definition. Loaded once at boot by the WorldClock autoload.
WorldClock is authoritative for the whole simulation - no other system tracks its own
This file is DATA ONLY (JSON = what things are). Timer advancement, signal emission, and
speed control live in WorldClock.gd (GDScript = what things do).
Keys beginning with '__' are documentation comments and are skipped by the loader.
time_scale.real_seconds_per_game_hour - wall-clock seconds per in-game hour at x1 speed
season_order      - canonical cycle; index into this drives day_of_year()
start             - new-game calendar position (matches WorldClock.gd defaults today)
event_times       - named time-of-day events in HOURS. Shared by the clock AND every sky/fog
curve in data/sky/sky_settings.json (curves key against these names).
day_length_curve  - seasonal day-length cosine from 11_overview.md S5. day_of_year 0-111;
summer solstice (longest day) at day 28, winter solstice at day 84.
daylight_hours(doy) = mean - amplitude * cos((doy - summer_solstice)/112 * TAU)
NOTE: rise/set 'peak' sub-events (sunrise_peak_start, etc.) used by Stonehearth are NOT defined
here yet. For v1, sky curves key only against the 8 base events below. If a softer shoulder is
needed later, add a 'rise_set_length_hours' field and derive peak events in WorldClock.
